entry.author: Sport New Zealand Ihi Aotearoa
entry.summary: Sir Brian Roche KNZM, Public Service CommissionerThe public service is changing rapidly, driven by fiscal pressure and rising expectations. Drawing on his experience leading system‑wide reform, Sir Brian shares practical insights on what this means for sport and recreation leaders. This session explores how to reduce complexity, make better use of data and technology and lift impact – without losing trust or purpose.
